summary: Tom Dunigan's list has an 'oatland island' entry whose note mentions the Savannah wildlife center; a Vanishing Georgia post describes an old water tower by the center's entrance and does not call it a lookout.

corrections.why: The only description found calls the structure at the center's entrance an old water tower scheduled for demolition, not a fire lookout. For human review.

notes_for_editor: The list line's note reads 'wildlife center from ?', and the elevation (13 ft) is low for a lookout. The only description found, a 2015 Vanishing Georgia post (the date is from the web address; the page shows none), calls it an old water tower scheduled for demolition, so this entry may not be a fire lookout. The proposed hidden correction is for a human to decide. A WebSearch summary of a Wikipedia article reported a 2004 transfer of the site to the school district, which conflicts with the blog's 1973 reading; unverified and not used. The Wikipedia article on the center has no lookout mention. No register, agency or news source found after two searches.
